Full LBT and colmat-rs routine mapping ​

Scope and classification ​

Lists all 5,146 canonical symbols exposed by LBT in Julia 1.13.4. LP64 / ILP64 are separate tables with the same canonical names. Types and ABIs are not omitted to claim blanket support. The colmat-rs target is b376b3ce209184df8b46c734f7882a21e31d3f58 in deps/upstream.toml. This is a static audit of connection candidates based on the public source. It is not the result of executing every candidate below. Results of actual Julia calls are recorded separately in Measured Julia API mapping.

  • Public numerical capability available: Numerical kernels such as LU, SVD, and eigenvalue decomposition are public. This does not mean the ABI is identical.

  • Storage conversion required: Differences exist in reflectors, permutations, band/packed storage, and so on. An adapter is not necessarily available yet.

  • Composition candidate: A candidate whose mathematical output can be produced by combining public kernels. Equivalence in LAPACK-specific algorithms, accuracy guarantees, or complexity is not claimed.

  • Partial: Basic factorizations exist, but condition estimates, fixed pivots, expert flags, and similar features are missing.

  • No independent public API (within reviewed scope): A determination within the recorded scope of revisions, types, storage formats, options, and semantic verification methods. It does not mean the mathematics cannot be implemented.

  • Unverified; insufficient evidence: Unregistered families, guesses based on names, and old unsupported classifications with insufficient confirmation records. Does not mean the public API is absent.

  • capability_status and capability_evidence record the public-feature assessment; adapter_lp64/ilp64 records the actual ABI connection; execution_evidence_status records the registration state of per-entry execution evidence; and independent_algorithm_status records verification of independent algorithms, all separately. not_catalogued does not mean untested. Do not infer the presence of an independent algorithm from not_assessed.

  • adapter is the actual LBT registration. Do not confuse the existence of a numerical feature, the ABI connection, and completed verification.

Machine-readable list of all symbols ​

The all-symbol TSV contains one row per symbol, with the name, C/Fortran ABI, type, public-feature classification, LP64/ILP64 connection status, source evidence, and restrictions. The generation-metadata JSON is also saved.

ABICanonical symbols
LAPACKE2,605
Fortran2,329
CBLAS212

The current adapter registers LP64 3116 and ILP64 3116 symbols. GEEVX condition estimation is delegated to the existing backend rather than the native one. This is not a change that provides all of LAPACKE.

GGQRF / GGRQF / GGLSE / GGGLMnative-backed QR/RQ, Q application, and triangular solve compositionExternal reflector compatibility, equality constraints, minimum norm, and INFO=1/2 for exact rank failure. Allocates internal coefficients and scratch
TREXC / LAEXC / TRSEN / GEESXNative checked Schur moves and the existing GEESCondition estimation uses the saved original ILP64 routines. Converts rejection indices, the total selected SDIM, integer work arrays, and the callback ABI
TREVC / TREVC3Public Schur eigenvectors, reversed adjoint, and back-transformationSIDE L/R/B, HOWMNY A/B/S, SELECT/M for real pairs, and max-component normalization. Native rejections use the saved original LAPACK
LACPY / LASET / LASWPNative LACPY/LASET/LASWP and direct row-major conversionReads and writes only the logical rectangle and selected triangle. LASWP swaps whole rows and preserves Fortran ordering for INCX<0
TGEVCEigenvector back-substitution from an existing S/P Schur pencil and Q/Z back-transformationPorts LAPACK's guarded small solves to Rust. SIDE L/R/B, HOWMNY A/S/B, real conjugate pairs, infinite eigenvalues, and max-component normalization. C API is #288
LANGE / LANSY / LANTRNative matrix norms and row-major transpose viewsM/1/O/I/F/E, symmetric/triangular storage, and the unit diagonal. Returns a real value, not INFO
GESVDQSVD with native QR preprocessingTransposes A and writes it back (QR factors); U is M×M for JOBU=A, N×N for F, and M×N otherwise (R has NUMRANK columns); V is written back as the logical NUMRANK or N rows by N columns. High-level entry points query IWORK/WORK/RWORK
GGESXNative generalized Schur decomposition (reordering and condition estimation)Passes the SELECTCTG callback to native reordering and transposes A/B/VSL/VSR before writing everything back. Queries WORK/LWORK/LIWORK, and the high-level entry adds slack to LWORK for the TGSYL stage of SENSE
TGSENNative cluster reordering of a generalized Schur pairSELECT is a LOGICAL (integer) array. Transposes A/B/Q/Z and writes everything back, querying WORK/LWORK/LIWORK. The TGSYL stage for IJOB>=1 needs at least one more LWORK element than the queried minimum, so the high-level entry adds slack
GESVDXNative selected singular value decompositionRANGE=A/V/I; row-major U is M×NS and VT is NS×N, writing back only the selected NS pairs. The high-level entry queries WORK/LWORK and uses SUPERB as integer workspace
BDSQR / BDSDC / BDSVDX / LASQ1Native bidiagonal SVD and selectionU/VT/C application, COMPQ N/I, RANGE A/V/I, and ascending output. The compact P of BDSDC is delegated to the saved original ILP64 LAPACK
LAPMR / LAPMTNative row/column permutationThe row-major path converts only the logical rectangle. Preserves K and forward/backward
ORGTR/UNGTR and ORMTR/UNMTRNative tridiagonal Q formation and applicationThe row-major path preserves the selected triangle and converts the logical rectangle. Converts UPLO/SIDE/TRANS and the lwork query
ORGBR/ORMBR and ORGHR/ORMHRNative bidiagonal/Hessenberg Q formation and applicationConverts VECT/SIDE/TRANS/ILO/IHI and the lwork query. The row-major path handles only the logical rectangle
TREVCNative Schur eigenvectorsSIDE/HOWMNY/SELECT/M, real conjugate pairs, and row-major logical-rectangle conversion. C ABI is #288
TREXCNative Schur block moveCOMPQ V/N, IFST/ILST, and the ABI difference between real pointers and complex by-value arguments. C ABI is #288
LASCLNative safe-range scalingTYPE G/L/U/H/B/Q/Z, the number of row-major band rows, CFROM/CTO, and INFO. C ABI is #288
LACGV / LACP2Native conjugation and real-to-complex copyINCX and the selected triangle, plus row-major conversion from real A to complex B. LACGV has no layout argument
TRSENNative checked Schur selection (JOB=N)SELECT/M, reordering, and row-major T/Q. JOB E/V/B use the saved original LAPACK
LARFGNative Householder generatorNo layout argument; converts INCX and TAU/alpha/x directly
LARFTNative block reflector triangular factorDIRECT/STOREV and row-major V/T conversion. Preserves the transpose convention of T
LARFBNative block reflector applicationSIDE/TRANS/DIRECT/STOREV and row-major V/T/C conversion. WORK length is K
LARTGP / LARTGSNative Givens rotation with scalar guardsNo layout argument; converts by-value f/g/sigma and the NaN ordering

SYTRF/SYTRS/SYSV and HETRF/HETRS/HESVNative dense Bunch-Kaufman LUUPLO, IPIV, WORK query, and row-major A/B. SY uses S/D and HE uses C/Z

GEEQU / GEEQUBNative dense equilibrationR/C/ROWCND/COLCND/AMAX and row-major logical-rectangle conversion of A. GEEQUB scales by powers of two
GGES / GGES3Native generalized Schur driverJOBVSL/JOBVR/SORT, alpha/beta, row-major A/B/VSL/VSR, and the GGES3 work query
HSEQRnative Hessenberg Schur decompositionJOB E/S、COMPZ N/I/V、ILO/IHI、WR/WI vs W、row-major H/Z
GEQR/GELQ and GEMQR/GEMLQNative blocked QR/LQ interfacesT/TSIZE descriptors, row-major A (R×K and K×R), row-major C, and work queries
PBEQU / PBSTF / PBSVNative positive-definite band extrasS/SCOND/AMAX, the split Cholesky factor, row-major band AB (KD+1 rows), and B
PFTRF / PFTRI / PFTRSNative RFP CholeskyTRANSR/UPLO, transposition of the RFP rectangle (ROW×COL), and row-major B
TRTTF/TFTTR, TFTTP/TPTTF, TPTTR/TRTTPNative full/RFP/packed conversionTransposition of the RFP rectangle (dtf_trans), packed pp_trans reordering, and row-major A/LDA
BDSQR, BDSDC, BDSVDXNative bidiagonal SVDTransposes and writes back VT/U/C; BDSDC validates COMPQ=N/I (COMPQ=P is only passed to the native compact fallback); BDSVDX writes back only the columns returned in the 2N-row [U;V] Z
GETSLS, GETSQRHRT, ORGTSQR_ROW/UNGTSQR_ROW, ORHR_COL/UNHR_COLNative tall-skinny least squares and TSQR Householder reconstructionT is an NB×(N*number of slots) array and the row-major LDT must be at least the number of columns. GETSLS/GETSQRHRT/ORGTSQR_ROW query WORK/LWORK and transpose A/B/T before writing back
LAG2C/LAG2D/LAG2S/LAG2Z, LACRM/LARCM, PSTRFNative precision conversion, complex×real matrix products, and pivoted CholeskyRow-major conversion and write-back. LAG2* overflow reports a positive INFO, LACRM/LARCM have no INFO (column-major argument errors come only from the native checker), and PSTRF writes back only the triangle and passes through PIV/RANK
SYTRD/HETRD and SYEQUB/HEEQUBNative dense tridiagonalization and diagonal scalingNaN checks and write-back only on the UPLO triangle; SYTRD/HETRD query WORK/LWORK; SYEQUB/HEEQUB treat A as read-only and use CABS1 for complex types
STEVX/STEVR/STEGR/STEMRNative selected tridiagonal eigenvaluesNaN checks only for D/E (N elements for E in STEMR); row-major Z only for returned columns; STEVR/STEGR/STEMR query WORK/IWORK; STEMR passes NZC/TRYRAC
Not connected (no independent native public API): GEJSV/GESVJNoneThe S/D/C/Z GEJSV and GESVJ (Jacobi SVD) have no numerical entry point on the colmat-rs/Colmat.jl side. Ordinary SVD is not substituted to make them succeed, and they are not registered with LBT (the standard LAPACK is left in charge).
Not connected (different contract): complex symmetric CSY_/CSP* and ZSY_/ZSP*** (SYTRF/SYTRS/SYSV/SYTRI/SYTRI2/SYTRI2X/SYTRS2, SPTRF/SPTRS/SPSV/SPTRI, and their ROOK variants)NoneNative Bunch-Kaufman has a Hermitian LDL^H contract, so the factors and IPIV of complex symmetric LDL^T are different. The Hermitian version is not substituted, and these are not registered with LBT (the standard LAPACK is left in charge).
Unverified modes—BDSDC COMPQ=P (compact form) only forwards to the native compact fallback. The row-major paths of BDSQR/BDSDC/BDSVDX verify COMPQ=N/I and all modes of BDSQR/BDSVDX.
SYEVX/HEEVX, SYGVX/HEGVX, SBGVX/HBGVX, SPGVX/HPGVXNative selected eigenvalues (dense, band, and packed, including generalized)NaN checks and write-back only on the UPLO triangle; row-major Z only for returned columns; SYEVX/SYGVX query WORK/LWORK; the band Q is transposed only for JOBZ=V
SBEVX/HBEVX, SPEVX/HPEVX, SPTRD/HPTRDNative band/packed selected eigenvalues and packed tridiagonalizationConverts band AB and packed AP to column-major and writes back; row-major Q/Z only for JOBZ=V, and Z writes back only returned columns. WORK/IWORK(/RWORK) are allocated at fixed length
SBGST/HBGST/SPGST/HPGST, SBGV/HBGV/SPGV/HPGV, SBGVD/HBGVD/SPGVD/HPGVDNative band/packed generalized self-adjointConverts band AB/BB (KA+1/KB+1 rows) and packed AP/BP to column-major and writes back, transposing row-major Z/X. GST reads the split or ordinary Cholesky factor of B read-only. GVD variants query WORK/IWORK(/RWORK)
SYGST/HEGST, SYGV/HEGV, SYGVD/HEGVDNative generalized self-adjoint definite problemsITYPE 1–3. NaN checks only on the UPLO triangle; row-major A is the full matrix for JOBZ=V and triangular otherwise; B's triangle is written back. GST reads B read-only. GVD variants query WORK/IWORK(/RWORK)
TGEXCNative reordering of a generalized Schur pair (QZ reorder)Real IFST/ILST are input/output pointers, while complex ones are passed by value. Transposes A/B/Q/Z and queries the native routine directly
SYTRF/SYTRS/SYSV_ROOK and HETRF/HETRS_ROOKNative rook Bunch-KaufmanFactors and IPIV (negative 2×2 pivots) are used interchangeably in row/column-major. Complex symmetric CSYTRF_ROOK and HESV_ROOK are out of scope
SFRK/HFRKNative RFP rank-k updatealpha/beta are passed by value, and the RFP rectangle (ROW×COL) and row-major A are transposed. No INFO is returned, so column-major argument errors come only from the native checker
SBEV/HBEV/SPEV/HPEV and SBEVD/HBEVD/SPEVD/HPEVDNative band/packed full eigen-decompositionConverts band AB (KD+1 rows) and packed AP to column-major and transposes row-major Z. EVD variants allocate through WORK/IWORK(/RWORK) queries
STERF/STEQR/STEV/STEVD/STEDCNative tridiagonal EVD (QL/QR, divide and conquer)STERF has no matrix_layout. Row-major Z is read as input only for COMPZ=V, and STEDC/STEVD allocate through WORK/IWORK(/RWORK) queries
SPTRI, HPTRF/HPTRS/HPSV/HPTRI, SYTRS2/HETRS2Native packed Bunch-Kaufman and dense solvesReorders packed AP with pp_trans and excludes the imaginary part of the Hermitian diagonal from NaN checks. SYTRS2 allocates N elements without using WORK
SYTRI/HETRI, SYTRI2/HETRI2, SYTRI2X/HETRI2XNative Bunch-Kaufman inverseFactors and IPIV are used interchangeably. The row-major path checks NaN and writes back only the UPLO triangle; TRI2 queries WORK; TRI2X uses a work area of (N+NB+1)*(NB+3)
POEQU/POEQUB, PPEQU, PPSV/PPTRINative positive-definite equilibration and packed extrasS/SCOND/AMAX (dense/packed), factor write-back for PPSV, and factor to inv(A) for PPTRI
TFSM / TFTRI and PTSVNative RFP triangular operations and positive-definite tridiagonal solvesSIDE/UPLO/TRANS/DIAG, row-major RFP rectangle transposition and B, and D/E with row-major B for PTSV
TGEXC / TGEX2 / TGSEN / GGESXPublic QZ reorder and eigenvalue extraction from saved factorsCondition and separation estimates use the existing ILP64 LAPACK. Converts integer arrays and callback LOGICAL, and allocates internal matrices
SBTRD/HBTRD/SPTRD/HPTRD and OPGTR/UPGTR/OPMTR/UPMTRNative tridiagonalization / HouseholderBand/packed expansion, external AP/TAU interoperability, and the X*Q update for VECT=U. Not a dedicated band bulge chase
GST/GV/GVD/GVX for SBG/HBG/SPG/HPGNative triangular/split Cholesky, congruence transformation, and full EVDConverts packed ITYPE and the band split factor. The GVX Q is the full generalized eigenbasis, and positive ABSTOL and boundary guards use the saved original LAPACK
SYEVR / HEEVRFull EVD and A/I/V range selectionDoes not provide native MRRR / Sturm count

Full list of connection candidates and unsupported routines ​

The following is grouped by family. For each row, all applicable symbols are listed explicitly. Types are kept in the TSV as s/d/c/z, and everything else as other. Evidence links point to the public source at the pinned revision. Restrictions within a row do not mean that they have been verified to satisfy every LAPACK contract.

gbmv / Fortrancgbmv_, dgbmv_, sgbmv_, zgbmv_native interval matmul / packed outer products / triangular_solveConnects 44 Fortran BLAS symbols to both ABIs. Passes only the stored band/packed interval to native multiplication and distinguishes negative strides, complex symmetric versus Hermitian, real diagonals, and the unit diagonal. Triangular solves compose the interval's native dot product and a diagonal solve, and zero columns in the no-transpose case are skipped as in the reference Netlib. No full dense expansion; allocates internal storage for the X snapshot of the product and the necessary row gathers. C ABI is a separate task.

gbsv / Fortrancgbsv_, dgbsv_, sgbsv_, zgbsv_native column PartialPivLu / rank-one matmul / interval triangular_solveConnects 32 Fortran symbols to both ABIs. Factors the stored band columns with native LU and preserves LAPACK's interleaved IPIV and fill-in through row exchanges and skew-strided outer-product updates. Converts tridiagonal systems to an O(n) four-row band region and reads/writes DL/D/DU/DU2 and adjacent pivots. Supports N/T/C solves from external factors. GTSV also handles its own DL contract, stopping at the first singular pivot and preserving the partial B and second superdiagonal. No full dense expansion. C ABI is a separate task.

gebd2 / Fortrancgebd2_, dgebd2_, sgebd2_, zgebd2_native bidiag panels / LAPACK reflector gauge / native GEMV updatesConnects 20 Fortran symbols to both ABIs. Normalizes each active column/row, uses the single-column panel of native bidiag_in_place, and converts complex beta and the reciprocal-coefficient convention to LAPACK's real D/E, complex TAUQ/TAUP, and stored vectors. GEBRD/GEBD2 share the unblocked composition. LABRD updates its owned working matrix in sequence, preserving caller A22 while returning the first NB rows/columns and the deferred X/Y. Q/P are generated and applied left/right from the same storage form with native GEMV and rank-one updates. Handles the minimum length and query of caller WORK but allocates internal storage separately. Verifies four types, both ABIs, upper/lower bidiagonal form, rectangular shapes, and interoperability with external factors. C ABI is a separate task.

gtsv / Fortrancgtsv_, dgtsv_, sgtsv_, zgtsv_native column PartialPivLu / rank-one matmul / interval triangular_solveConnects 32 Fortran symbols to both ABIs. Factors the stored band columns with native LU and preserves LAPACK's interleaved IPIV and fill-in through row exchanges and skew-strided outer-product updates. Converts tridiagonal systems to an O(n) four-row band region and reads/writes DL/D/DU/DU2 and adjacent pivots. Supports N/T/C solves from external factors. GTSV also handles its own DL contract, stopping at the first singular pivot and preserving the partial B and second superdiagonal. No full dense expansion. C ABI is a separate task.

hbev / Fortranchbev_, zhbev_dense expansion / native full-spectrum self-adjoint EVDConnects 24 Fortran symbols to both ABIs. Expands the specified band/packed interval into an owned O(n^2) Hermitian matrix and uses the native full EVD. BEV/BEVD and PEV/PEVD share a path and do not claim dedicated band/packed algorithms. VX selects A/I/V from the full spectrum, band Q returns all eigenvectors, and AB returns the diagonalized tridiagonal matrix. Positive ABSTOL, native failures, and range endpoints inside the precision-based guard are passed to the saved ILP64 expert driver, converting LP64 integer arrays. Preserves the workspace query and minimum legal work but allocates the native internal region separately. C ABI is a separate task.

hbgst / Fortranchbgst_, zhbgst_factorized triangular/split B + native triangular_solve / matmul / reflectorsConnects eight Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. Packed GST reads an external triangular Cholesky factor and applies the congruence transformation for ITYPE=1/2/3. Band GST reads the PBSTF split factor S and, through native block triangular solves and reflector composition, forms C=X^H A X and X^H B X=I within the original bandwidth. Preserves the unspecified triangle, padding, and BB, and reads only the real part of the complex Hermitian diagonal. Allocates dense internal matrices and does not claim the same performance as a dedicated band bulge chase. Band native rejections use the saved ILP64 driver. C ABI is a separate task.

hbgv / Fortranchbgv_, zhbgv_native LLT / split-factor solves / self_adjoint_evdConnects 24 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. Packed input stores a triangular Cholesky factor and band input the PBSTF split factor; composes the congruence transformation, native full EVD, and B normalization. GVD also uses the common native EVD and does not claim the identically named divide-and-conquer algorithm. GVX selects A/I/V; the band full-basis Q returns generalized eigenvectors, and AB returns the diagonal tridiagonal form. Positive ABSTOL, native failures, and precision-guarded range endpoints are delegated to the saved original ILP64 driver, converting only written LP64 IWORK/IFAIL slots. Allocates an O(n^2) owned matrix and scratch. C ABI is a separate task.

hbmv / Fortranchbmv_, zhbmv_native interval matmul / packed outer products / triangular_solveConnects 44 Fortran BLAS symbols to both ABIs. Passes only the stored band/packed interval to native multiplication and distinguishes negative strides, complex symmetric versus Hermitian, real diagonals, and the unit diagonal. Triangular solves compose the interval's native dot product and a diagonal solve, and zero columns in the no-transpose case are skipped as in the reference Netlib. No full dense expansion; allocates internal storage for the X snapshot of the product and the necessary row gathers. C ABI is a separate task.

hbtrd / Fortranchbtrd_, zhbtrd_native tridiag / Householder generation and applicationConnects 16 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. SPTRD/HPTRD expand packed storage into an owned dense matrix and convert the real beta gauge of the existing native tridiagonalization to LAPACK AP/TAU form. OPGTR/UPGTR/OPMTR/UPMTR read only the valid tail of the packed reflector and share native Householder application. Zero coefficients in the tail, diagonal, and tridiagonal entries are not referenced when forming or applying Q. SBTRD/HBTRD expand the band and compose the same reduction, returning D/E with Q for VECT=V and X*Q for VECT=U. VECT=N does not reference Q. Complex band E is phase-adjusted to be nonnegative. Verifies fixed WORK, INFO, and storage guards. Internally owned matrices are O(n^2); no claim of the same performance as a dedicated band bulge chase. C ABI is a separate task.

hesv / Fortranchesv_, zhesv_cholesky::lblt::factor / solve / inverse (Partial pivoting)Connects 32 Fortran symbols for real SY / complex HE to both ABIs. hesv_rook / Fortranchesv_rook_, zhesv_rook_Bunch-Kaufman cholesky_in_place with LbltParams.pivoting=Rook/RookDiagConnects 20 Fortran symbols for real SY / complex HE to both ABIs. Uses public Rook pivoting and converts the two swap indices of each two-column block separately into ROOK IPIV. Verifies bidirectional solve/inverse with external LAPACK factors and reconstruction from element matrices. TRF/SV query and minimum caller work are 1, and internal scratch is natively owned. Symmetric congruence scaling for subnormal rows and common scaling for D/RHS blocks avoid native #212. LAPACKE waits for the shared conversion in #288. No claim of the same algorithm, pivot columns, or performance as the dedicated Fortran routines. Complex symmetric SY has a separate contract.

hpev / Fortranchpev_, zhpev_dense expansion / native full-spectrum self-adjoint EVDConnects 24 Fortran symbols to both ABIs. Expands the specified band/packed interval into an owned O(n^2) Hermitian matrix and uses the native full EVD. BEV/BEVD and PEV/PEVD share a path and do not claim dedicated band/packed algorithms. VX selects A/I/V from the full spectrum, band Q returns all eigenvectors, and AB returns the diagonalized tridiagonal matrix. Positive ABSTOL, native failures, and range endpoints inside the precision-based guard are passed to the saved ILP64 expert driver, converting LP64 integer arrays. Preserves the workspace query and minimum legal work but allocates the native internal region separately. C ABI is a separate task.

hpgst / Fortranchpgst_, zhpgst_factorized triangular/split B + native triangular_solve / matmul / reflectorsConnects eight Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. hpgv / Fortranchpgv_, zhpgv_native LLT / split-factor solves / self_adjoint_evdConnects 24 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. GVX selects A/I/V; the band full-basis Q returns generalized eigenvectors, and AB returns the diagonal tridiagonal form. hptrd / Fortranchptrd_, zhptrd_native tridiag / Householder generation and applicationConnects 16 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. SPTRD/HPTRD expand packed storage into an owned dense matrix and convert the real beta gauge of the existing native tridiagonalization to LAPACK AP/TAU form. pbstf / Fortrancpbstf_, dpbstf_, spbstf_, zpbstf_native diagonal Llt / triangular_solve / triangular::matmulConnects four Fortran symbols to both ABIs. Composes split Cholesky by eliminating the second half in reverse order, updating the first half, and then factorizing the first half forward. This is not a replacement by ordinary POTRF; A=S^H*S is reconstructed independently from the upper, lower, and crossing parts of S. The split point is min(n,(n+kd)/2), and nonexistent columns are not read even with an excess declared width. The difference that the reference PBSTF reads out-of-range columns when m>n is documented as a separate reproducer. C ABI is a separate task.

ptsv / Fortrancptsv_, dptsv_, sptsv_, zptsv_native LDL panels / unit band triangular_solve / real matmulConnects 16 Fortran symbols to both ABIs. Preserves real D and real/complex E, normalizes each column by a power of two, and uses the determined first column of the native LDL panel and the native real Schur update. Solves compose an O(n) unit band with a real diagonal solve and distinguish complex upper/lower conjugation. No full dense expansion. Verifies reuse of external factors, non-positive-definite INFO and partial output, tiny/huge values, empty/zero RHS, and mixed ABIs. The reference complex PTTS2 rewrite for a zero RHS and its N=1 reciprocal overflow are documented as separate reproducers; the native implementation avoids touching unused arrays and keeps finite solutions through normalization. C ABI is a separate task.

sbev / Fortrandsbev_, ssbev_dense expansion / native full-spectrum self-adjoint EVDConnects 24 Fortran symbols to both ABIs. Expands the specified band/packed interval into an owned O(n^2) Hermitian matrix and uses the native full EVD. BEV/BEVD and PEV/PEVD share a path and do not claim dedicated band/packed algorithms. VX selects A/I/V from the full spectrum, band Q returns all eigenvectors, and AB returns the diagonalized tridiagonal matrix. Positive ABSTOL, native failures, and range endpoints inside the precision-based guard are passed to the saved ILP64 expert driver, converting LP64 integer arrays. Preserves the workspace query and minimum legal work but allocates the native internal region separately. C ABI is a separate task.

sbtrd / Fortrandsbtrd_, ssbtrd_native tridiag / Householder generation and applicationConnects 16 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. SPTRD/HPTRD expand packed storage into an owned dense matrix and convert the real beta gauge of the existing native tridiagonalization to LAPACK AP/TAU form. OPGTR/UPGTR/OPMTR/UPMTR read only the valid tail of the packed reflector and share native Householder application. Zero coefficients in the tail, diagonal, and tridiagonal entries are not referenced when forming or applying Q. SBTRD/HBTRD expand the band and compose the same reduction, returning D/E with Q for VECT=V and X*Q for VECT=U. VECT=N does not reference Q. Complex band E is phase-adjusted to be nonnegative. Verifies fixed WORK, INFO, and storage guards. Internally owned matrices are O(n^2); no claim of the same performance as a dedicated band bulge chase. C ABI is a separate task.

spsv / Fortrandspsv_, sspsv_native LDL factor / solve / inverse + LAPACK pivot conversionSixteen real-symmetric/complex-Hermitian packed Fortran symbols connected for both integer ABIs. Selected packed triangles are staged into owned dense storage, sharing native LDL and LAPACK 1x1/2x2 IPIV conversion with dense Bunch-Kaufman. sptrd / Fortrandsptrd_, ssptrd_native tridiag / Householder generation and applicationConnects 16 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. SPTRD/HPTRD expand packed storage into an owned dense matrix and convert the real beta gauge of the existing native tridiagonalization to LAPACK AP/TAU form. OPGTR/UPGTR/OPMTR/UPMTR read only the valid tail of the packed reflector and share native Householder application. Zero coefficients in the tail, diagonal, and tridiagonal entries are not referenced when forming or applying Q. SBTRD/HBTRD expand the band and compose the same reduction, returning D/E with Q for VECT=V and X*Q for VECT=U. VECT=N does not reference Q. Complex band E is phase-adjusted to be nonnegative. Verifies fixed WORK, INFO, and storage guards. Internally owned matrices are O(n^2); no claim of the same performance as a dedicated band bulge chase. C ABI is a separate task.

sysv_rook / Fortrandsysv_rook_, ssysv_rook_Bunch-Kaufman cholesky_in_place with LbltParams.pivoting=Rook/RookDiagConnects 20 Fortran symbols for real SY / complex HE to both ABIs. Uses public Rook pivoting and converts the two swap indices of each two-column block separately into ROOK IPIV. Verifies bidirectional solve/inverse with external LAPACK factors and reconstruction from element matrices. TRF/SV query and minimum caller work are 1, and internal scratch is natively owned. Symmetric congruence scaling for subnormal rows and common scaling for D/RHS blocks avoid native #212. LAPACKE waits for the shared conversion in #288. No claim of the same algorithm, pivot columns, or performance as the dedicated Fortran routines. Complex symmetric SY has a separate contract.

tbmv / Fortranctbmv_, dtbmv_, stbmv_, ztbmv_native interval matmul / packed outer products / triangular_solveConnects 44 Fortran BLAS symbols to both ABIs. Passes only the stored band/packed interval to native multiplication and distinguishes negative strides, complex symmetric versus Hermitian, real diagonals, and the unit diagonal. Triangular solves compose the interval's native dot product and a diagonal solve, and zero columns in the no-transpose case are skipped as in the reference Netlib. No full dense expansion; allocates internal storage for the X snapshot of the product and the necessary row gathers. C ABI is a separate task.

tbtrs / Fortranctbtrs_, dtbtrs_, stbtrs_, ztbtrs_triangular_solveTwelve band/packed/RFP Fortran solve symbols connected for both integer ABIs. Selected triangles are staged into owned dense storage for native triangular solves; right-sided TFSM uses transposed native views. Band width, packed/RFP coordinates, complex transpose/conjugation and unit diagonals are explicit. TBTRS/TPTRS check singular diagonals before solving, including zero RHS columns. TFSM alpha=0 avoids A and old B reads. Internal dense storage is O(n^2); C API is separate.

trevc / Fortranctrevc_, dtrevc_, strevc_, ztrevc_eigenvectors_from_schur_real/cplx + reverse-adjoint left vectorsConnects eight Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. The right side uses the public Schur eigenvector helper, and the left side is generated from a reversed transpose/adjoint Schur form and then restored to the original column order. Converts SIDE L/R/B, HOWMNY A/B/S, normalization of real 2x2 pairs in SELECT and M/MM, back-transformation, packing of real conjugate pairs, and max-component normalization. TREVC3 shares the same native helper and matrix products and does not claim its own blocked back-substitution algorithm. The query returns the minimum WORK/RWORK of this composed path, and internally owned matrices/scratch are O(n^2). On native rejection it delegates to the saved original ILP64 TREVC/TREVC3, converting LP64 SELECT/M/INFO. C ABI is a separate task.

ung2r / Fortrancung2r_, zung2r_qr_in_place / Householder / triangular solveConnects 36 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. Provides A/TAU coefficient conversion, Q formation and left/right application, and GEQRS. The complex ordinary and nonnegative-diagonal variants generate LAPACK-gauge reflectors and preserve real beta. Allocates internal arrays, and no guarantee is made that each entry point uses the same Netlib implementation as its algorithm name.
ungbr / Fortrancungbr_, zungbr_native bidiag panels / LAPACK reflector gauge / native GEMV updatesConnects 20 Fortran symbols to both ABIs. Normalizes each active column/row, uses the single-column panel of native bidiag_in_place, and converts complex beta and the reciprocal-coefficient convention to LAPACK's real D/E, complex TAUQ/TAUP, and stored vectors. GEBRD/GEBD2 share the unblocked composition. LABRD updates its owned working matrix in sequence, preserving caller A22 while returning the first NB rows/columns and the deferred X/Y. Q/P are generated and applied left/right from the same storage form with native GEMV and rank-one updates. Handles the minimum length and query of caller WORK but allocates internal storage separately. Verifies four types, both ABIs, upper/lower bidiagonal form, rectangular shapes, and interoperability with external factors. C ABI is a separate task.

upgtr / Fortrancupgtr_, zupgtr_native tridiag / Householder generation and applicationConnects 16 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. SPTRD/HPTRD expand packed storage into an owned dense matrix and convert the real beta gauge of the existing native tridiagonalization to LAPACK AP/TAU form. OPGTR/UPGTR/OPMTR/UPMTR read only the valid tail of the packed reflector and share native Householder application. Zero coefficients in the tail, diagonal, and tridiagonal entries are not referenced when forming or applying Q. SBTRD/HBTRD expand the band and compose the same reduction, returning D/E with Q for VECT=V and X*Q for VECT=U. VECT=N does not reference Q. Complex band E is phase-adjusted to be nonnegative. Verifies fixed WORK, INFO, and storage guards. Internally owned matrices are O(n^2); no claim of the same performance as a dedicated band bulge chase. C ABI is a separate task.

amax / Fortrandamax_, samax_MatRef::min/max/sum + real-precision abs1 and first-index selectionFourteen Fortran symbols connected for both integer ABIs. Real MAX/MIN/SUM borrow strided vectors; absolute extrema and IAMIN allocate real comparison values and use native min/max. gees / Fortrancgees_, dgees_, sgees_, zgees_hessenberg_schur_real/cplx / reorder_schur_real/cplx / HouseholderConnects 20 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. gegs / Fortrancgegs_, dgegs_, sgegs_, zgegs_QR / generalized_hessenberg / hessenberg_to_qz / generalized reorder_schurConnects 16 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. Converts the HGEQZ active range and Q/Z=N/I/V, the dense reduction of GGES/GGES3/GEGS, homogeneous alpha/beta, SELECT and real conjugate pairs, and SDIM. Preserves beta=0. Because the native API does not return a non-convergence state, the structure and outputs are validated, and an incomplete result reports the whole active range as non-converged with INFO=IHI. Re-evaluates QZ after reordering. Allocates internal arrays and scratch and provides the minimum legal WORK and query for each entry point.

gels / Fortrancgels_, dgels_, sgels_, zgels_QR / LQ / SVD / RZ / triangular solveConnects 28 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. Full-rank cases use QR/LQ, GELSS/GELSD use the common native SVD, and GELSY/GELSX use fixed-column QR and RZ for a complete orthogonal factorization. The leading-R condition test uses singular values and therefore has a different rounding path from Netlib's incremental estimate. Converts scaling, rank, residuals, and the layout of B, and allocates internal arrays.

gemqr / Fortrancgemqr_, dgemqr_, sgemqr_, zgemqr_native compact-WY QR panels / Householder block application / modified LU with native matmul and triangular solveTwenty-eight Fortran symbols connected for both integer ABIs. LATSQR stores separate T blocks for the initial row panel and each subsequent [R;B] panel, preserving earlier reflectors. TSQR Q generation/application gathers the correct noncontiguous row/column blocks. GEQR implements the five-entry header, optimal/minimal TSIZE/LWORK queries and compact fallback; GEMQR reads external GEQR metadata. ORHR_COL/UNHR_COL reconstruct Q through modified LU of Q-[D;0], native trailing updates and native triangular solves. GETSQRHRT composes TSQR, explicit thin Q, reconstruction and D*R. Internal temporary storage is owned by the adapter; ORGTSQR_ROW uses the common explicit-Q path and does not claim the reference in-place row algorithm. C API is separate.

geql2 / Fortrancgeql2_, dgeql2_, sgeql2_, zgeql2_reversed native-backed QR / adjoint QR LQ / prefix Householder applicationForty-eight Fortran symbols connected for both integer ABIs. Both axes are reversed around existing standard QR/LQ, then triangular placement and TAU order are reversed back. QL uses H(k)...H(1); complex RQ uses H(1)^H...H(k)^H with conjugated row-vector storage. Thin Q uses the last columns (QL) or rows (RQ). Generation snapshots only stored reflector tails, and application skips zero coefficients and validates only active prefix extents. Blocked/unblocked names share an unblocked composition and own temporary storage; they do not claim dedicated native QL/RQ APIs or reference blocking performance. C API is separate.

geqp3 / Fortrancgeqp3_, dgeqp3_, sgeqp3_, zgeqp3_QR / reflector application / residual column normsConnects four Fortran types and LP64/ILP64. gges / Fortrancgges_, dgges_, sgges_, zgges_QR / generalized_hessenberg / hessenberg_to_qz / generalized reorder_schurConnects 16 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. ggglm / Fortrancggglm_, dggglm_, sggglm_, zggglm_native-backed QR/RQ, reflector apply, triangular solve compositionConnects 16 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. GGLSE/GGGLM compute equality-constrained and minimum-norm solutions from the same factors and distinguish two kinds of exact triangular rank failure as INFO=1/2. iamin / Fortranicamin_, idamin_, isamin_, izamin_MatRef::min/max/sum + real-precision abs1 and first-index selectionFourteen Fortran symbols connected for both integer ABIs. Real MAX/MIN/SUM borrow strided vectors; absolute extrema and IAMIN allocate real comparison values and use native min/max. Complex IAMIN compares abs(real)+abs(imag), rounded in the real input precision, and returns the first 1-based logical index. Negative strides return zero without reading X; zero stride returns the first (absolute) value for extrema and zero for SUM/IAMIN.

lange / Fortranclange_, dlange_, slange_, zlange_real modulus reductions / induced row-column sums / normalized native norm_l2Fifty-four Fortran symbols connected for both integer ABIs across dense, Hessenberg, tridiagonal, symmetric/Hermitian, triangular, band, packed and RFP storage. larz / Fortranclarz_, dlarz_, slarz_, zlarz_Householder generation / native GEMV and GEMMConnects 32 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. Constructs the upper-trapezoidal [R 0]Z and sparse reflectors. LARZT/LARZB provide the backward and row-preserving behavior specified by LAPACK. Handles conjugation of complex T and overlap between implicit components and the tail, and does not read the central region on which they do not act. Allocates internal arrays.

max / Fortrandmax_, smax_MatRef::min/max/sum + real-precision abs1 and first-index selectionFourteen Fortran symbols connected for both integer ABIs. Real MAX/MIN/SUM borrow strided vectors; absolute extrema and IAMIN allocate real comparison values and use native min/max. Complex IAMIN compares abs(real)+abs(imag), rounded in the real input precision, and returns the first 1-based logical index. Negative strides return zero without reading X; zero stride returns the first (absolute) value for extrema and zero for SUM/IAMIN.

org2l / Fortrandorg2l_, sorg2l_reversed native-backed QR / adjoint QR LQ / prefix Householder applicationForty-eight Fortran symbols connected for both integer ABIs. Both axes are reversed around existing standard QR/LQ, then triangular placement and TAU order are reversed back. QL uses H(k)...H(1); complex RQ uses H(1)^H...H(k)^H with conjugated row-vector storage. Thin Q uses the last columns (QL) or rows (RQ). Generation snapshots only stored reflector tails, and application skips zero coefficients and validates only active prefix extents. Blocked/unblocked names share an unblocked composition and own temporary storage; they do not claim dedicated native QL/RQ APIs or reference blocking performance. C API is separate.

orm22 / Fortrandorm22_, sorm22_native rectangular / triangular block matmulConnects the four Fortran symbols of ORM22/UNM22 to both ABIs. Distinguishes the row partition (N1,N2) and column partition (N2,N1) of Q and applies the lower part of Q12 and the upper part of Q21 with native triangular matmul. Does not read the unspecified triangle or leading-dimension padding. Handles left/right, real N/T, complex N/C, and empty blocks, allocating an O(m_n) internal result in the same form as C and copying it back at the end. The query is m_n, and the minimum work for the actual computation is NQ as in the reference execution code (1 for empty blocks). Even at the minimum length, native internal storage is needed separately. C ABI is a separate task.

QL uses H(k)...H(1); complex RQ uses H(1)^H...H(k)^H with conjugated row-vector storage. Thin Q uses the last columns (QL) or rows (RQ). Generation snapshots only stored reflector tails, and application skips zero coefficients and validates only active prefix extents. Blocked/unblocked names share an unblocked composition and own temporary storage; they do not claim dedicated native QL/RQ APIs or reference blocking performance. C API is separate.; C ABI connected for LP64/ILP64; #288 tests explicit layout/char/integer/INFO contracts and DLL/LBT routes; NaN policy helpers retain C-int flags in both interfaces

ormrz / Fortrandormrz_, sormrz_Householder generation / native GEMV and GEMMConnects 32 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. Constructs the upper-trapezoidal [R 0]Z and sparse reflectors. LARZT/LARZB provide the backward and row-preserving behavior specified by LAPACK. Handles conjugation of complex T and overlap between implicit components and the tail, and does not read the central region on which they do not act. Allocates internal arrays.

ormtr / Fortrandormtr_, sormtr_tridiag_in_place / normalized Householder + native gemv / Hermitian rank-2Twenty Fortran symbols connected for both integer ABIs. Ordinary real reductions use native tridiagonalization in its safe scale range; complex real-E gauge and extreme real scales compose normalized native Householder panels with native matrix-vector and Hermitian rank-2 updates. Upper/lower storage, real D/E, Q generation/application and LATRD deferred W panels are adapted explicitly. Internal temporary storage is owned by the adapter; TRD accepts minimum LWORK=1, without claiming the reference blocked algorithm. C API is tracked separately.

pstf2 / Fortrancpstf2_, dpstf2_, spstf2_, zpstf2_single-pivot native LLT / native GEMMEight Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs are connected. The adapter controls pivoting together with LAPACK TOL/INFO/PIV and composes a native LLT and a native GEMM Schur update for each pivot. The automatic tolerance is N_DLAMCH(E)_largest diagonal. It stops at TOL after the first positive pivot and returns the completed factors, the uncomputed permuted triangle, and the stopping diagonal. PSTRF/PSTF2 share the sequential path and allocate internal matrices and scratch.

sum / Fortrandsum_, ssum_MatRef::min/max/sum + real-precision abs1 and first-index selectionFourteen Fortran symbols connected for both integer ABIs. Real MAX/MIN/SUM borrow strided vectors; absolute extrema and IAMIN allocate real comparison values and use native min/max. Complex IAMIN compares abs(real)+abs(imag), rounded in the real input precision, and returns the first 1-based logical index. Negative strides return zero without reading X; zero stride returns the first (absolute) value for extrema and zero for SUM/IAMIN.

ung2l / Fortrancung2l_, zung2l_reversed native-backed QR / adjoint QR LQ / prefix Householder applicationForty-eight Fortran symbols connected for both integer ABIs. Both axes are reversed around existing standard QR/LQ, then triangular placement and TAU order are reversed back. QL uses H(k)...H(1); complex RQ uses H(1)^H...H(k)^H with conjugated row-vector storage. Thin Q uses the last columns (QL) or rows (RQ). Generation snapshots only stored reflector tails, and application skips zero coefficients and validates only active prefix extents. Blocked/unblocked names share an unblocked composition and own temporary storage; they do not claim dedicated native QL/RQ APIs or reference blocking performance. C API is separate.

Handles ILO/IHI partial ranges and interoperates with external A/TAU. GEHRD/GEHD2 share the path and allocate internal arrays.

ungtsqr / Fortrancungtsqr_, zungtsqr_native compact-WY QR panels / Householder block application / modified LU with native matmul and triangular solveTwenty-eight Fortran symbols connected for both integer ABIs. LATSQR stores separate T blocks for the initial row panel and each subsequent [R;B] panel, preserving earlier reflectors. TSQR Q generation/application gathers the correct noncontiguous row/column blocks. GEQR implements the five-entry header, optimal/minimal TSIZE/LWORK queries and compact fallback; GEMQR reads external GEQR metadata. ORHR_COL/UNHR_COL reconstruct Q through modified LU of Q-[D;0], native trailing updates and native triangular solves. GETSQRHRT composes TSQR, explicit thin Q, reconstruction and D*R. Internal temporary storage is owned by the adapter; ORGTSQR_ROW uses the common explicit-Q path and does not claim the reference in-place row algorithm. C API is separate.

GEQR implements the five-entry header, optimal/minimal TSIZE/LWORK queries and compact fallback; GEMQR reads external GEQR metadata. ORHR_COL/UNHR_COL reconstruct Q through modified LU of Q-[D;0], native trailing updates and native triangular solves. GETSQRHRT composes TSQR, explicit thin Q, reconstruction and D*R. Internal temporary storage is owned by the adapter; ORGTSQR_ROW uses the common explicit-Q path and does not claim the reference in-place row algorithm. unm22 / Fortrancunm22_, zunm22_native rectangular / triangular block matmulConnects the four Fortran symbols of ORM22/UNM22 to both ABIs. Distinguishes the row partition (N1,N2) and column partition (N2,N1) of Q and applies the lower part of Q12 and the upper part of Q21 with native triangular matmul. Does not read the unspecified triangle or leading-dimension padding. Handles left/right, real N/T, complex N/C, and empty blocks, allocating an O(m_n) internal result in the same form as C and copying it back at the end. The query is m_n, and the minimum work for the actual computation is NQ as in the reference execution code (1 for empty blocks). Even at the minimum length, native internal storage is needed separately. C ABI is a separate task.

Generation snapshots only stored reflector tails, and application skips zero coefficients and validates only active prefix extents. Blocked/unblocked names share an unblocked composition and own temporary storage; they do not claim dedicated native QL/RQ APIs or reference blocking performance. C API is separate.

geesx / Fortrancgeesx_, dgeesx_, sgeesx_, zgeesx_Schur and reorder_schurConnects eight Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. TRSEN JOB=N performs stable selection with native Schur block moves, plus M, eigenvalue extraction, and Q updates. GEESX SENSE=N uses the existing native GEES path. On rejected swaps, SDIM returns the total number of selected columns rather than the moved prefix (the common GEES handling is fixed too). No public native API exists for S/SEP or RCONDE/RCONDV, so JOB/SENSE E/V/B are delegated to the saved original ILP64 routines. For LP64, only written IWORK/BWORK slots are converted, and the SELECT callback converts the LOGICAL ABI with a thread-local guard, restoring it after nested calls. TRSEN handles only LWORK=-1, and real GEESX performs the collective LWORK/LIWORK query. Allocates internally owned matrices and scratch. C ABI is a separate task.

trsen / Fortranctrsen_, dtrsen_, strsen_, ztrsen_Schur and reorder_schurConnects eight Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. TRSEN JOB=N performs stable selection with native Schur block moves, plus M, eigenvalue extraction, and Q updates. GEESX SENSE=N uses the existing native GEES path. On rejected swaps, SDIM returns the total number of selected columns rather than the moved prefix (the common GEES handling is fixed too). No public native API exists for S/SEP or RCONDE/RCONDV, so JOB/SENSE E/V/B are delegated to the saved original ILP64 routines. For LP64, only written IWORK/BWORK slots are converted, and the SELECT callback converts the LOGICAL ABI with a thread-local guard, restoring it after nested calls. TRSEN handles only LWORK=-1, and real GEESX performs the collective LWORK/LIWORK query. Allocates internally owned matrices and scratch. C ABI is a separate task.

Direct ABI execution evidence (#317, #271) ​

direct_call_witness covers 2,912 canonical entries, with LP64 and ILP64 recorded separately. The ABI evidence snapshot identifies the exact source/native revisions, manifest and test source SHA-256 hashes. Stale evidence is rejected. CBLAS records completed named DLL/LBT calls explicitly: enums stay Cint, dimensions/strides use the selected integer ABI, and ROTG has no integer arguments. LARTG/LARTGP/LARTGS have no integer arguments; their entry names still distinguish the two LBT tables. Shared native addresses do not identify individual aliases; named LBT stubs provide that evidence. The collector observes project-owned pointer ccalls. High-level standard-library calls, isolated child processes and static symbol/library ccalls are excluded. Consult the individual source/signature/route witnesses and the numerical tests together.

sh
julia --project -e 'using Pkg; Pkg.test(; allow_reresolve=false)'
python3 docs/import_abi_execution.py test-output/abi-execution.toml

Linux/macOS CI collects the same evidence during the ordinary full suite and saves separate ABI artifacts.

Original candidate set and the 51 re-reviews ​

Retains the history of the 2,910 candidates and 51 items from the original #262 snapshot (3c850a88a05b3c09eadd84d3722b1704cf1421f1 / native e1c83482f5a61449d30e989808c3ba5f751ec391). The all-canonical per-owner re-review TSV and the JSON of audit conditions and original Issue body hashes are recorded separately. Fortran/CBLAS are mapped to the original explicit lists, and LAPACKE to the shared ABI scope of #288 and the numerical Issues of the Fortran counterparts. The numerical counterparts of the 148 LAPACKE candidates belong to #262, which was connected at the baseline. The ownership of the shared ABI and the registration of numerical counterparts are not proof that all contracts are implemented or verified. Adds the 40 candidates (20 Fortran and 20 LAPACKE) that overlooked public rook pivoting, tracked in Issue #372. This is a classification correction because public enums/fields also exist in the original baseline, not the addition of a new native API. With the correction, the original candidate set contains 2,950 entries. No symbols were removed from the original positive API determinations. Of the old unsupported classifications, 1,918 were separated as unverified and are not dropped from the candidates as absent independent public APIs. They are not judged to be numerically implemented or confirmed as additional features.

Separate columns for classification and evidence ​

ColumnMeaning
capability_status / colmat_apiClassifies semantic correspondence of public numerical features, storage format, partial support, and unverified status
capability_evidence / evidence_statusVerified revision, types, storage, options, verification method, public source, and reason. Absence determinations with insufficient records are not adopted
adapter_lp64 / adapter_ilp64Measured current LBT registrations. Separate from whether a public API exists
execution_evidence_status / execution_evidencedirect_call_witness records a completed concrete call through a DLL or LBT entry. It does not certify every option, numerical contract or independent algorithm. not_catalogued does not mean untested.
independent_algorithm_statusVerification status of a dedicated independent algorithm. Currently not_assessed. Do not infer a dedicated algorithm from the existence of a basic solver or API

Regeneration and completeness checks ​

The public API assessments are kept in docs/lbt-capabilities.json, and the actual symbol set is obtained from LBT. Routines with no registered rule and old unsupported determinations with insufficient evidence are retained as "Unverified; insufficient evidence". Suffixes/prefixes are not evidence of absence.

sh
python3 docs/generate_lbt_inventory.py
julia --project=test test/lbt_inventory.jl
python3 -m unittest discover -s docs/tests -v

To regenerate the candidate re-review, pass the TSV of the pinned snapshot (git show 3c850a88a05b3c09eadd84d3722b1704cf1421f1:docs/src/assets/lbt-symbol-inventory.tsv) and a JSON containing the original 51 Issue bodies to python3 docs/audit_lbt_candidates.py --baseline-tsv ORIGINAL.tsv --issue-snapshot docs/audits/issue-263-scope-snapshot.json --rook-issue 372. The output records body hashes and retrieval times, and does not confuse past bodies with the current snapshot.

This audit is a public API mapping of a pinned source. If public features are added later, re-read the classification rules and restrictions and update it.
